fixtureSource.groundTruth: Frozen sidecar benchmark/visual/action-state-sidecar.json. Every label is read from the OpenFox HTTP API at capture time (GET /api/sessions phase/isRunning, GET /api/providers reachability, route path). No label is derived from pixels or from a filename.

limitations: The corpus is partial: 14 admitted cases against a contract target of 31. processing, blocked and auth_required are absent because no usable LLM provider is reachable in this environment (see benchmark/visual/action-state-manifest.json).
A GO verdict cannot be issued on 14 cases covering only 4 of 7 states. The safety bar (false-positive success) is measured and clean, but three critical states are untested.
These System One / openjev-latest results are backend-specific and do not imply another provider or model shares this calibration.

unknownFallbackRate stays null because the backend exposes no explicit abstention channel; the four ambiguous cases were answered unknown through the choice rubric, not through a declared fallback policy.

freeze.note: corpusManifest is the harness-loadable manifest (schemaVersion 1, parseable by scripts/visual-spike-lib.ts loadManifest). corpusCatalogue is the non-loadable inventory that records coverage, blocker and sha256 per state; the manifest was generated from the sidecar. Images live under benchmark/visual/action-state/. Measured with a single primary run, no per-case retry, every malformed response preserved.

provenance.modelRuntimeNote: openjev-latest is an alias for openjev-0.1 per the System One /v1/models listing captured on 2026-10-03; the alias is retained in the measured rows because it is what the harness actually sent.
provenance.imagePreprocessing: PNG bytes read from disk and inlined verbatim as a base64 data URL; no resize, crop, re-encode or normalisation is performed by the harness.
provenance.rerunCommand: VISUAL_BACKEND=systemone VISUAL_MANIFEST=benchmark/visual/action-state-cases.json VISUAL_FIXTURE_ROOT=benchmark/visual VISUAL_ENDPOINT=https://api.codiv.ai/v1/systemone VISUAL_MODEL=openjev-latest VISUAL_API_KEY=<operator key> npm run visual:spike
provenance.credentialHandling: The provider key is supplied by the operator through the environment only. It is never read from this repository and never persisted in any committed artefact.
